elements.name: Virgo
elements.text: Virgo: attentive discernment and productive solitude, a focus on detail that reveals the bigger picture.

elements.name: Lantern
elements.text: The lantern he carries: the light that leads him step by step, focusing on detail as he searches for his spiritual center.
